description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao class, which provides data access methods for managing employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes functions for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching immigration records, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for handling CRUD operations and searches for EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves or updates an EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity, assigning a new recordId if necessary, and ensures the recordId is within valid range before persisting.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeImmigrationRecord by employee number and record ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeImmigrationIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing immigration record IDs for a given employee number from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes specified immigration records for an employee based on record IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Returns all immigration records for a specific employee, ordered by record number.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Performs a filtered search of immigration records based on search parameters, returning the matched records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsPaginator
methods.description: Internal method to set up a paginator with search filters and sorting for immigration records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immigration records matching the search filter criteria.
